47-1/4 Inch Vertical Rod Replacement Kit For Use with Hager Series 4700 Surface Vertical Rod Panic Devices

This is a rod replacement kit for Hager 4700 surface vertical rod panic device. It measures 47-1/4 inches. The Hager Vertical Rod for a Maximum of 8ft. Devices from the 4700 Collection; it can be cut down to 7' if needed. Hager vertical rods are strong and secure.

Features and Specifications of the Hager Vertical Rod for a Maximum of 8ft. Devices from the 4700 Collection:

  • Aluminum Construction
  • Fits 8' Device but Can be Cut Down to 7' Device
  • Package includes: rod guide, rod connector assembly, and all appropriate screws

Special Ordered Item. NO RETURNS
